title: ceammc.dyn
description: `ceammc.dyn` is the ceammc library’s index for dynamic signal-processing objects, covering mono and stereo compressors, expanders, gates, limiters, and soft clipping. Use its links to open the help patch for the specific dynamics object you need, such as `dyn.comp~`, `dyn.gate2~`, or `dyn.softclip~`.
